questions.content: Câu 1: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Many species are threatened with extinction due to deforestation and loss of habitat.
options: A. Deforestation and loss of habitat threaten many species so that they will become extinct.
B. Many species lost their habitat because of deforestation and now they are extinct.
C. Deforestation and loss of habitat are driving many species to the verge of extinction.
D. Many species are extinct, so they run the risk of deforestation and loss of habitat.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “are threatened with extinction” = “are driving to the verge of extinction” (đang bị đe dọa tuyệt chủng). Dịch nghĩa: Nạn phá rừng và sự mất môi trường sống đang đẩy nhiều loài đến bờ vực tuyệt chủng.

questions.content: Câu 2: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Motor vehicles running on petrol are responsible for a large amount of carbon dioxide emission.
options: A. Because of releasing a large amount of carbon dioxide, motor vehicles run on petrol.
B. A large amount of carbon dioxide emission results from motor vehicles running on petrol.
C. A large amount of carbon dioxide emission causes motor vehicles to run on petrol.
D. Emitting a large amount of carbon dioxide is one of the responsibilities of motor vehicles running on petrol.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “are responsible for” (chịu trách nhiệm cho) = “results from” (kết quả từ) Dịch nghĩa: Lượng lớn khí CO₂ phát thải là do các phương tiện chạy bằng xăng.

questions.content: Câu 3: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Global warming has proven truly catastrophic for the environment.
options: A. The environment has been made catastrophic by global warming.
B. It is true that global warming is a catastrophe caused by the environment.
C. It has been proven that global warming is harmful to the environment.
D. The environment has been truly dangerous because of global warming.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “proven catastrophic for” = “proven harmful to” (chứng minh rằng có hại). Dịch nghĩa: Đã được chứng minh rằng hiện tượng ấm lên toàn cầu gây hại cho môi trường.

questions.content: Câu 4: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The alarming rate of deforestation results in damage to the quality of the land.
options: A. It is alarming that deforestation damages the quality of the land.
B. The quality of the land deteriorates as the result of the alarming rate of deforestation.
C. The alarming rate of deforestation results from damage to the quality of the land.
D. The damage to the quality of the land is to blame for the alarming rate of deforestation.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: “results in” = “as the result of” (là kết quả của) Dịch nghĩa: Chất lượng đất suy giảm là kết quả của tốc độ phá rừng đáng báo động.

questions.content: Câu 5: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Not many people are aware of the dangers of plastic bags to the environment.
options: A. People are totally unaware of the dangers of plastic bags to the environment.
B. People are fully aware of the dangers of plastic bags to the environment.
C. The dangers of plastic bags to the environment came to the attention of only a few.
D. It is time that people were aware of the dangers of plastic bags to the environment.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “Not many people are aware” = “only a few know” (chỉ ít người biết) Dịch nghĩa: Chỉ một số ít người nhận ra mối nguy của túi nilon đối với môi trường.

questions.content: Câu 6: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Climate change leads to numerous catastrophic consequences.
options: A. Numerous catastrophic consequences result in climate change.
B. Numerous catastrophic consequences result from climate change.
C. Climate change results from numerous catastrophic consequences.
D. Numerous catastrophic consequences cause climate change.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: B Giải thích: Cấu trúc tương đương: “A leads to B” = “B results from A”. Dịch nghĩa: Nhiều hệ quả thảm khốc là hệ quả của biến đổi khí hậu.

questions.content: Câu 7: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. The increase in earth’s temperature can cause heat-related illnesses.
options: A. Heat-related illnesses result from the increase in earth’s temperature.
B. Heat-related illnesses result in the increase in earth’s temperature.
C. Heat-related illnesses lead to the increase in earth’s temperature.
D. Heat-related illnesses trigger the increase in earth’s temperature.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: A Giải thích: “cause” (dẫn tới) => “result from” (là kết quả của) Dịch nghĩa: Các bệnh liên quan đến nắng nóng là hệ quả của việc nhiệt độ Trái Đất tăng.

questions.content: Câu 8: Choose the sentence which has the closest meaning to the original one. Carbon dioxide is one of the primary greenhouse gases that cause global warming.
options: A. Carbon dioxide is the only greenhouse gas that causes global warming.
B. Global warming results in greenhouse gases, including carbon dioxide.
C. One of the main greenhouse gases that lead to global warming is carbon dioxide.
D. Global warming causes greenhouse gases, including carbon dioxide.
questions.note: Đáp án đúng: C Giải thích: “cause” = “lead to” (dẫn tới). Dịch nghĩa: Một trong những khí nhà kính chính dẫn tới ấm lên toàn cầu là CO₂.
